sources.snippet: This repository provides code and examples for efficient parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of BLIP-2 vision-language models with a LLaMA-2 7B backbone using LoRA adapters. sources.title: Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models for Visual Navigation Assistance
sources.snippet: We fine-tune the BLIP-2 model with Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on a manually annotated indoor navigation dataset. We propose an evaluation metric that refines the BERT F1 score by emphasizing 'directional' and 'sequential' variables, providing a more comprehensive measure of navigational performance.
